source: Coalescing therefore connects thread mapping to memory performance. The same tensor can be cheap or expensive to read depending on which dimension neighboring lanes traverse and how the data is laid out. AS07 will treat this deeply; AS01 only needs the architectural insight: memory traffic is generated collectively by groups of threads, so address pattern matters.
zh: 因此，合并将线程映射与内存性能联系起来。读取相同的张量可能很便宜也可能很昂贵，具体取决于相邻通道遍历的维度以及数据的布局方式。 AS07将对此进行深入处理； AS01 只需要了解架构：内存流量是由线程组共同生成的，因此地址模式很重要。
